title: Lec 47 LSTMs and GRUs
channel: NPTEL - Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru

topics.title: From Multiplicative Jacobians to Additive State Transitions: The Unified Gating Formulation
topics.summary: Prof. Prathosh reviews the multiplicative Jacobian contraction causing vanishing gradients in vanilla RNNs, dismisses the naive spectral norm fix lambda_max=1, and formalizes the general additive state transition ht = alpha_t * ht-1 + beta_t * h_tilde_t establishing an unattenuated memory conveyor belt.

topics.title: Architectural Taxonomy & The Gating Spectrum: Highway Networks, GRUs, and LSTMs
topics.summary: Derives Highway Networks (beta=1), Gated Recurrent Units (beta=1-alpha), and Long Short-Term Memory networks (independent learnable gates) as exact special cases of the unified additive abstraction, de-biologizing memory into learnable gating functions.

topics.title: Mathematical Proof of Gradient Preservation: Deriving the Additive Jacobian & The Unattenuated Transmission Operator
topics.summary: Presents the rigorous zero-leap proof deriving the additive Jacobian dht/dht-1 = diag(alpha_t) + E_t, expanding the cumulative multi-step Jacobian chain, and establishing unattenuated identity transmission approx I when alpha approx 1.

topics.title: Spatial vs. Temporal Skip Duality: ResNets, Transformers, Deep Stacked Recurrent Networks, and the Inductive Bias / Regularization Worldview
topics.summary: Establishes the structural duality between spatial residual skips (ResNets, Transformers) across depth and temporal additive highways across time steps, explores deep stacked RNNs, and anchors architectural innovations within bias-variance regularization and KL divergence minimization.
